title: Rawframe AttemptPlan, generation 1
description: The declared benchmark schedule an Evidence Set is assembled against, per ADR-0019 and SPEC-0014. It states what was scheduled before anything ran, so that what did run can be checked against it. It is an input to assembly and never an evidence authority: it carries no observation, no status, and no verdict. The schedule counts are what make an omission detectable, because an assembler handed only a list of attempts cannot tell a complete list from a favorable subset of one.

tier.description: The evidence tier this schedule was declared for. Tier 0 is the only value this gate admits; the others exist in SPEC-0014 and are refused here rather than silently accepted.

schedule.description: What was scheduled, fixed before execution. attemptCount includes retries; repetitionCount does not, so a schedule with retries has attemptCount greater than repetitionCount.

attempts.description: Every scheduled attempt, exactly once. An attempt whose run produced no receipt still appears here; it is the absence of its receipt that assembly reports, and removing the entry to make assembly succeed is the manipulation this record exists to prevent.

receipt.description: The descriptor of this attempt's Raw Run Receipt, or null when the attempt produced none. Null is an accounted-for absence rather than a missing member, so a plan cannot omit the question.
